description: This file defines the IMEUtil class, providing utility methods for input method editor (IME) operations such as calculating edit distance, removing duplicate suggestions, trimming suggestions, and extracting IME action IDs from EditorInfo objects.

classes.name: IMEUtil
classes.description: A utility class for input method editor (IME) related functions such as calculating edit distances, managing suggestion lists, and interpreting EditorInfo options.

methods.name: editDistance
methods.description: Calculates the Damerau-Levenshtein distance between a given word and a character array segment, used for spell checking or similarity measurement.

methods.name: removeDupes
methods.description: Removes duplicate suggestions from a list, preserving the first occurrence.

methods.name: tripSuggestions
methods.description: Reduces the suggestions list to a maximum number of suggestions by removing excess suggestions.

methods.name: removeSuggestion
methods.description: Removes a suggestion at a specified index and adds it to the strings pool if it is a StringBuilder.

methods.name: getImeOptionsActionIdFromEditorInfo
methods.description: Extracts the IME action ID from an EditorInfo object, considering flags such as IME_FLAG_NO_ENTER_ACTION.
